# `llm` command

Manage the local LLM harness.

```bash
fobis llm <subcommand> [options]
```

How to use it, with examples: [Models, knowledge and agents](/cookbook/ai-setup).

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## All options

### `fobis llm ask`

Ask the configured model a question (smoke test, scripting); the answer streams to standard output.

Arguments: `PROMPT`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--schema` | TEXT |  | JSON Schema file: the answer is constrained to it. |
| `--system` | TEXT |  | System prompt. |
| `--provider` | TEXT |  | managed, ollama or openai. |
| `--model`, `-m` | TEXT |  | Model (alias or spec for managed). |

### `fobis llm doctor`

Check the local LLM setup: platform, runtime, model, and (managed) a timed sample answer.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--sample`, `--no-sample` |  |  | Start the model and time a short answer. |

### `fobis llm list`

List the models in the store.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` |  |  | Machine-readable output. |

### `fobis llm pull`

Download a model into the store (resumable; verified against the Hub's sha256).

Arguments: `MODEL`

No options.

### `fobis llm recommended`

List curated models (alias, size, licence): nothing is downloaded.

No options.

### `fobis llm rm`

Remove a model from the store.

Arguments: `MODEL`

No options.

### `fobis llm runtime`

Install, list and remove the llama.cpp runtime (llama-server).

#### `fobis llm runtime install`

Download, verify and install llama-server (the pinned build by default).

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--variant` | TEXT | `auto` | auto, cpu, metal, cuda12, cuda13, vulkan, rocm or sycl. |
| `--build` | TEXT |  | A llama.cpp build tag other than the pinned one. |
| `--sha256` | TEXT |  | Expected sha256 of a non-pinned build. |
| `--trust` |  |  | Accept a non-pinned build without a known sha256. |

#### `fobis llm runtime list`

List the installed llama.cpp builds.

No options.

#### `fobis llm runtime remove`

Remove an installed llama.cpp build.

Arguments: `NAME`

No options.

### `fobis llm serve`

Keep a llama-server running between commands (start, stop, status).

#### `fobis llm serve start`

Start a persistent llama-server; later commands with the same model use it instead of starting their own.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--model`, `-m` | TEXT |  | Model to serve (default: the configured one). |

#### `fobis llm serve status`

Show the persistent llama-server, if one is running.

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--json` |  |  | Machine-readable output (without the API key). |

#### `fobis llm serve stop`

Stop the persistent llama-server.

No options.

<!-- cli:end -->
